name: Planetarium
title: Planetarium
summary: A field of Empyrean ruins on a mesa (z 56) near Candeth Keep (78.8S 73.8W): a Falacatot-style octagonal temple with a spire roof (6756, 5556, 14.7 m), a broken three-storey advocate hall with a stone chair on its roof (6804, 5559, 19.4 m), an Empyrean stone tower on the hill to the north (6780, 5676, 27.9 m) and a Life Stone below the mesa to the east (6859, 5527, z 44).

site.name: Planetarium
site.notes: Derived teleport on the mesa between the octagon temple and the advocate hall (the gazetteer Direlands Desert Edge drop point sits inside a brick ruin model).

shots.standingOrder: Orbit a tenth of a turn 95 m out and 32 m above the Empyrean ruins on the mesa with the sun behind; keep 20 m above the mesa edge.
shots.notes: A tenth of an orbit 95 m out and 32 m above the mesa around the octagonal Empyrean temple, the broken advocate hall and the stone tower on the hill beyond; the mesa's cliffs and the Life Stone below, sun behind. Subject point = the octagon temple.
